description: This file defines classes and functions for resampling time series data within the pandas API on PySpark, including Resampler, DataFrameResampler, and SeriesResampler, with methods for aggregation like min, max, sum, mean, std, and var.

classes.name: Resampler
classes.description: Abstract base class for resampling datetimelike data, providing common interface and methods for aggregation.

classes.name: DataFrameResampler
classes.description: Concrete implementation of Resampler for pandas-on-Spark DataFrames, handling output and attribute access.

classes.name: SeriesResampler
classes.description: Concrete implementation of Resampler for pandas-on-Spark Series, handling output and attribute access.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Compute the minimum value in each resampling interval.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Compute the maximum value in each resampling interval.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Compute the sum of values in each resampling interval.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Compute the mean of values in each resampling interval.

methods.name: std
methods.description: Compute the standard deviation of values in each resampling interval.

methods.name: var
methods.description: Compute the variance of values in each resampling interval.
